products.name: Microsoft Teams Meetings, Webinars & Policy Configuration — Commercial
products.short_description: Configure Teams meetings & webinars — meeting policies (lobby/recording/roles), webinars/town halls, templates + sensitivity, and group-based assignment — so meetings are secure and consistent. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Configure Teams meetings and webinars for a secure, consistent experience

Default meeting settings leave lobby, recording, and external-join controls inconsistent — a security and experience gap. This solution configures Teams meetings and webinars: meeting policies (lobby, recording/transcription, presenter roles), live events/webinars/town halls, meeting templates and sensitivity, and policy assignment by group — so meetings are secure, consistent, and fit-for-purpose.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the meeting model: meeting policies, webinars/town halls, templates + sensitivity, recording/transcription, and policy assignment.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites with how to verify/implement (Teams licensing incl. Premium where used, admin roles, groups, compliance stance).
  • Implementation Guide — design + apply meeting policies, configure webinars/town halls, build meeting templates + sensitivity, set recording/transcription policy, and assign by group — pilot-first, each policy named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic MicrosoftTeams PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (policies applied by group, lobby/recording correct) plus Best Practices for consistent, secure meetings.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Teams meetings secure and consistent — lobby, recording, and roles set by policy, webinars/town halls configured, templates applied — fit-for-purpose across the org.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • TEAMSMTG-AssignmentReport.ps1 — Scope/health helper (SAFE BY DEFAULT - reports unless -AssignGroup ... -Commit): reports group policy
    • TEAMSMTG-Discovery.ps1 — Discovery (READ-ONLY): produces the "Meeting Posture - Teams - Discovery" snapshot of Teams meeting
    • TEAMSMTG-Set-EventsAndTemplates.ps1 — Configuration (SAFE BY DEFAULT - preview unless -Commit): idempotently creates/updates the Teams events
    • TEAMSMTG-Set-MeetingPolicy.ps1 — Configuration (SAFE BY DEFAULT - preview unless -Commit): idempotently creates/updates the Teams
    • TEAMSMTG-Validation.ps1 — Validation (READ-ONLY): pass/fail check that the named meeting policies exist and match the design, the

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
